note: Small Alberta Parks campground 17 km southwest of Lodgepole on Hwy 620 and 47 km west on Elk River Road, run by West Fraser Mills / Fox Creek Development Association. Large, well-spaced sites in mixed forest; some sites have a view of the river. No-charge firewood. OHV and horse trails are nearby but not allowed inside the recreation area. Closed until further notice after wildfire damage. --Claude

SEASON FIX: stored season 02-03..10-15 is the phone-reservation window; the camping season is 'May 1 - Oct 31'. Wrote season 05-01..10-31 and booking.season 02-03..10-15.

POLICY ROW (policy_ref stays null): booking is by phone with the operator, West Fraser Mills / Fox Creek Development Association, at 780-865-2154; the page says 'The reservation fee is non-refundable' without an amount (Fairfax Lake's West Fraser page, same operator, states a C$10 reservation fee). The provincial:AB row's C$12 fee / 90-day window / 10-night max do not describe this campground. The stored fees.note's 'GST included' was not stated on the page and was dropped.
SENIORS LINE: present ('This campground qualifies for the camping fee discount for Alberta seniors.').
PHONE: stored 780-865-2154 matches 'Information: 780-865-2154' (also the reservation line). Confirmed. Facility Operator 'West Fraser Mills-Fox Creek Development Association'.
WEBSITE: stored AP camping page answered 200 and is this campground. West Fraser's FRMA list has no Elk River page (www.westfraser.com/.../campgrounds/elk-river answered 404).

WATERFRONT (stored riverview, kept): the page says 'Some sites have a view of the river.' On the 2018-08-10 Esri capture (pre-fire) the loop's spurs run NE of the Elk River (~10-15 m wide); the nearest spur ends ~30 m from the bank, the others ~40-60 m, all through continuous conifer forest. No open ground to the water, so the riverfront gate is not met; riverview stays (the agency's view line). The stored evidence's 'open grass at oxbow inside bend' is a meadow across the river from the loop, not campsites. Imagery predates the fire.

PIN (52.9474,-116.1054): in the campground's south side just above the river, ~90 m SE of the page's directions point 52.948163,-116.105909 (the entrance off Elk River Road). Within the campground; no move.
OHV WORDING (not a drop candidate): 'There is nearby access to OHV and horse trails, though they are not permitted inside the recreation area.'
